references.text: Describes the inheritance of the tribe of Naphtali, which included the area around the Sea of Galilee and extending southward, fulfilling the blessing to possess 'the sea and the southland'.
Jacob's blessing over Naphtali as a freed hind with beautiful words, a parallel blessing over the same tribe.
The prophecy that Naphtali's land would be glorified, fulfilled by the Messiah's ministry in the Galilee region.
Jesus began his ministry in Capernaum in the territory of Naphtali, by the sea, thus fulfilling the blessing of God's favor over this area.
Kedesh in Naphtali was designated as a city of refuge, a sign of the Lord's blessing upon the tribe.
